items.title: Transformer Semantic Genetic Programming
items.summary: Trained an encoder–decoder transformer (~934K parameters, 5M expression pairs) to act as the variation operator inside a genetic programming loop, replacing the usual crossover and mutation. Batched decoding and graph compilation cut inference from 1,375 ms to 84 ms per individual, turning a 291-hour benchmark grid into 10.5 hours.

items.title: Competitive Intelligence Agent
items.summary: Built the goal-decomposition layer of a plan-then-execute agent on Gemma 4 with Gemini embeddings — 6 registered tools, native function calling, SQLite memory, and RAG over a Chroma vector store. Planning lifted answer accuracy from 0.95 to 1.00 and cut mean latency from 91.9 s to 75.1 s; retries, observation caps and batching held a 16K token/min budget and took a classification pass from ~45 min to ~1 min.

items.title: Global Wheat Head Detection
items.summary: End-to-end Faster R-CNN + ResNet-50 detection pipeline for wheat heads in field images. Improved results 17% using cut-mix, mix-up, mixed precision, test-time augmentation, and weighted box fusion.

items.title: Very Fast Neural Style Transfer
items.summary: Fine-tuned a VGG16-based encoder–decoder to stylize images of any size in real time — reducing style generation for 512×512 images from 1.5 hours to 1 second (98% faster). Train your own model for any style.

items.title: Automatic Attendance System
items.kicker: CCTV face recognition at classroom scale
items.summary: Face detection and recognition system that marks attendance for an entire classroom simultaneously from CCTV footage, with real-time student-engagement scoring to grade lecture quality.

items.title: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection & Grading
items.summary: Automated detection and grading of diabetic retinopathy using CNNs. Published in the Turkish Journal of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, 32(3), 874–882 (Choudhary, Y., Eliazer, M., & Jain, A.).
